blocks.text: We are short at the front of the office Thursday and Friday, so I have put together coverage before anyone books time out and it turns into a scramble. Nothing complicated. I just want the phones answered and the door watched both days. Here is what I have, and tell me where it does not hold.

items: Thursday: Carol Cooper on the phones and the door through the morning, and I will take it from noon.
Friday: Jennifer Johnson at the front desk, with me as backup if she needs a hand.
Mail and the supply run each morning: whoever is in first, and let me know if we are low on anything before Thursday.

blocks.text: If either day is a problem for you, say so today and I will move things around.
